title: When Governments Fail, the People Respond

body:
Climate Change is a fork in the road. Will humanity choose greed, apathy, and civilizational suicide – or will we choose a change of heart, values, and civilizational renewal? Our current government has chosen the suicidal path, but we can still take action.

 (This will be a major theme of my work with Convergence Leadership Project – learn more here.)

 One thing all of us can do right now (if we have savings or retirement accounts) is convert our investments from dirty fossil fuels to clean renewable energy. I’ve done this, and hope you will too.  Learn more here.
